s3.text: V1 is the one to build. It keeps the Closet's own layout intact — the pig in the middle, her slots down both sides — so dressing her works exactly as it does today, just at the top of the store instead of in a separate room. It also keeps the shop's two modes distinct: the cosmetics shop lives on this page (shelves under the fitting room, the Closet grid further down the same scroll); the furnishings shop stays its own place behind the Furnish door beside the chalkboard, because it dresses the Barn, not the pig. V2 gives the outfit a wide card and a pinned peg rail; V3 puts her on the store floor. Both set aside.

sA.text: What jumps today: Store → sign → Closet (new page, scroll lost) → back via a Store sign that only exists away from the store; buying and wearing each open a sheet. A removes the rooms: one scroll, the pig pinned at the top, Wear tags on every card, the Closet grid a section further down. Pen and Furnish stay as small doors.

sB.text: B keeps the rooms (least code moved) but fixes the two things that read as jumping: the sign rail is identical in every room, and a tapped coaster opens a try-on strip under its own shelf instead of a sheet. Only buying confirms in a sheet. Each room keeps its scroll.

sC.text: C makes the tab one place: shelves fill it; your pig waits in a drawer that peeks above the tab bar. Tap a coaster and the drawer tries it on. Pull the drawer up and it is the Closet, with Pen and Furnish as doors in its head. Nothing navigates.

t3.text: A2 · the hero fitting room — V1 (flanked) is the build. V2 and V3 kept for the record.

tA.text: A · One aisle — no rooms. The fitting room is pinned; the closet is further down the same scroll.

tB.text: B · Signs that stay put — rooms stay, the rail never moves; try-on happens under the shelf.

tC.text: C · The fitting-room drawer — one screen; your pig lives in a drawer over the shelves.

m3.text: Two modes, one rule: what dresses the PIG is sold and worn here (shelves, fitting room, Closet grid, the Pen's companions). What dresses the BARN is sold in the furnishings shop — Furnish is a door out, never a room in. The Store sign is gone: this page is the store.
